subject: Private Offer MAP — Aurelia Health: onramp, billing path, and acceptance timeline
messages:
From: Emma Winters <emma.winters@aureliahealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Aurelia / Redwood — Private offer & MAP kickoff

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for last week's demo — the platform looks solid and our team is excited to move an evaluation forward. Procurement asked me to capture a simple mutual action plan so we can show Finance the timeline to commit. High level asks from our side:

- Ability to close via AWS Marketplace private offer (preferred) — we need the billing flow documented (marketplace invoice vs vendor invoice).
- Evaluation window: 4 weeks with a tech-acceptance gate (performance and data handling).
- Legal review: one-week turnaround on NDA/PO terms.
- Invoicing and payment: single invoice monthly preferred; Finance prefers net-30.

Can you send a short MAP with milestones, who owns each action, and what the billing path looks like? I've attached the procurement questionnaire they asked for (aurelia_procurement_questions.pdf).

Also copying our procurement alias so they see the ask.

Appreciate it — we'd like to run the eval starting the week of Sep 22 if that works.

Best,
Emma Winters
Head of Procurement, Aurelia Health
Attachment: aurelia_procurement_questions.pdf (pdf)
From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Emma Winters <emma.winters@aureliahealth.com>, Procurement Team <procure@aureliahealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Sep 2025 13:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Aurelia / Redwood — Private offer & MAP kickoff

Hi Emma — thanks for the clear checklist. This is doable and I sketched a concise MAP below to align expectations. Attaching an editable spreadsheet (redwood_mpa_draft.xlsx) with owners and dates.

Proposed MAP (high level)
- Sep 10: Redwood sends MAP + pricing confirmation (Grace) — DONE (attached).
- Sep 12: Aurelia confirms evaluation objectives & billing preference (Emma / Procurement).
- Sep 22: Evaluation start (Aurelia technical team) — 4 weeks, with automated perf tests and two joint checkpoints (week 1 & week 3) (Owners: Aurelia + Redwood SE).
- Oct 20: Technical acceptance sign-off (Aurelia) -> Redwood prepares private offer paperwork (Karthik).
- Oct 23: Legal + PO execution (Aurelia legal / Redwood legal) — target 1 week.
- Nov 01: Billing live (Marketplace private offer route) and first invoice cycle (Finance).

Notes on billing path: we support two common flows for private offers — 1) Marketplace-mediated invoice (Aurelia receives invoice via AWS Marketplace; funds routed per AWS terms) and 2) Vendor-invoice (Redwood issues monthly invoice based on usage). For enterprise customers opting for vendor-invoice we typically require a short finance addendum to capture payment terms and invoicing cadence.

Action items for Procurement
- Confirm preferred billing flow (Marketplace invoice vs Redwood invoice)
- Share billing contact and remit details if vendor-invoice is preferred
- Agree on eval acceptance criteria and a technical point of contact for the checkpoints

I'll coordinate Karthik for the private-offer paperwork once you confirm billing preference. Linking the MAP draft here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD-Redwood-Aurelia-MPA

Cheers,
Grace O'Connor
Sr. Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood_mpa_draft.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Hiro Tanaka <hiro@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Sep 2025 10:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Aurelia / Redwood — Private offer & MAP kickoff

Grace / team — quick internal note on billing options before we lock the MAP:

- Marketplace invoice (preferred from Aurelia's earlier notes): lower procurement friction for customers using AWS billing center. Redwood receives settlement via AWS; invoicing cadence follows AWS Marketplace terms which are usually monthly. If Aurelia wants net-30 on Redwood invoices we need to go vendor-invoice route and include a finance addendum.
- For vendor-invoice route we should prepare a simple SOW appendix that lists committed forecast ranges and the overage pricing buckets to avoid month-one reconciliation issues.

Risks: vendor-invoice requires Finance ops to set up Customer A/R onboarding (~5 business days) — if Aurelia needs the account active by Nov 1, Marketplace private offer speeds timeline.

I'll prepare the private-offer template and the two-stub invoice examples tomorrow. Also, Lauren — can you confirm if we can extend a modest introductory credit for the eval (2K USD) to speed the PO? If so, we should surface it in the MAP as a clear acceptance incentive.

Karthik
Director, Marketplace & Deals, Redwood Inference
From: Emma Winters <emma.winters@aureliahealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Sep 2025 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Aurelia / Redwood — Private offer & MAP kickoff

Thanks, Grace and Karthik — this is great and aligns with procurement's expectations. Aurelia prefers the AWS Marketplace private offer route (simpler for Finance) and we'll plan the eval start on Sep 22 as suggested.

Procurement action items (we'll take these on):
- Confirm billing contact and remit info (will send by Sep 15).
- Provide acceptance criteria (tech team will share by Sep 18).
- Legal will review Redwood's private-offer paperwork once Karthik sends the template.

We also appreciate the offer of an eval credit — please include the credit terms in the MAP draft. Once we have the final MAP and private-offer link from Redwood we'll route to Finance for the PO.

Onward — Emma
Emma Winters
Head of Procurement, Aurelia Health
Procurement Team <procure@aureliahealth.com>
